title: Remarks at Livingston, Montana
paragraphs: I shall not try to talk to you. I shall merely say that I have had a most pleasant fortnight's holiday, and that I have enjoyed so much being in your great and beautiful state. In about a month I shall be back in the western part of it, and I look forward to coming here again. Good night, and good luck!(Applause)
